answer: The violet multiplier is published, charged in knoll, and pearl lists each payment. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 8 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 3844 identities would post 859 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
